dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hello, Nam? This is Emma. Can you hear me?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ, ˈnɑːm? ˈðɪs ɪz ˈɛmə. kən juː ˈhɪr miː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, Emma. I can't hear you. Speak up, please!
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈɛmə. aɪ ˈkænt ˈhɪr juː. ˈspiːk ˈʌp, ˈpliːz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Can you hear me now? Where are you?
dialogue.reading: kən juː ˈhɪr miː ˈnaʊ? ˈwɛr ər juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I'm on the bus. Sorry!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪm ɑːn ðə ˈbʌs. ˈsɑːri!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. Are you coming to the movie?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ər juː ˈkʌmɪŋ tə ðə ˈmuːvi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I am. See you at seven!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈæm. ˈsiː juː ət ˈsɛvən!
